item.title: Grieving mother speaks out after man accused of murdering her son has bond reduced twice
item.description: A grieving mother said the justice system is failing her. item.description: The entire 517-mile stretch of the Big Bend Sector is set to receive some sort of border protection upgrade and contracts for wall projects are expected to be awarded within weeks.

item.title: Which Texas state parks are the most popular? These were the most visited in 2025
item.description: In total, state parks welcomed over 9.2 million visitors in 2025. About a third of those visits were made in a region of parks that ranges from the DFW Metroplex to an area west of Houston.
